description: Resend the notification email for one of YOUR OUTGOING pending friend requests by request_id (from friend_requests_pending). This re-emails the recipient, so confirm with the user first and pass confirmed=true. Throttled on an escalating cadence (60s after the original send, 24h after the first resend) and capped at 2 total resends per request.

confirmed.description: Must be true. Set only after the user confirms they want to resend.

request_id.description: The outgoing request id from friend_requests_pending.

name: friend_request_resend
title: Resend Friend Request
